profile.tagline: books, songs, colors, fav characters, and little happy moments as a fangirl🍎
profile.bio: Hi, welcome to my little orchard! I'm Apel 🍎 — honeyfriedapple if you're feeling fancy. I love reading, collecting songs, red-purple combos, fictional characters, and writing little things. Poke around and get to know me a bit 💌
profile.sideLeft: "you're the apple of my eye" means someone is cherished—
profile.sideRight: I have a lot of love to give — to everyone and everything
facts: 📚 really love any kind of reading
🎧 has a song on repeat at all times

writings.title: My first page
writings.body:
Write anything here — a poem, a short essay, a diary entry, a thought you had on the bus.

New lines work too, and long writings get their own scroll inside the page.

writings.title: A letter to my future self

motivations: You don't have to bloom all at once.
Be the apple of your own eye.
Rest is part of the work, too.
Curiosity is a superpower — use it.
